title: Algebraic properties of twisted Alexander polynomial and Reidemeister torsion of torus knots
summary: In this paper we prove that every coefficient of twisted Alexander polynomials of torus knots associated with irreducible $\mathrm{SL}_n(\Bbb C)$-representations is an $\Bbb A$-valued locally constant function on the $\mathrm{SL}_n(\Bbb C)$-character variety, where $\Bbb A$ is the ring of all algebraic integers over $\Bbb C$. Moreover, as a generalization of a recent result of Kitano and Nozaki, we show that $\mathrm{SL}_n(\Bbb C)$-Reidemeister torsions are algebraic integers for many Seifert fibered spaces.
